acceptance
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 150
    steps:
      - name: Check out the exact revision
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Install Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: ${{ env.NODE_VERSION }}
          cache: npm
      - name: Install native PHP callback tools
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y build-essential cmake composer curl libgmp-dev libuv1-dev pkg-config php-cli php-common php-mbstring php-zip unzip zstd ripgrep
          npm ci --ignore-scripts
          bash scripts/bootstrap-toolchains.sh --lean-only
          if /usr/bin/php -r 'exit(extension_loaded("xdebug") ? 0 : 1);'; then
            sudo phpdismod -s cli xdebug
          fi
      - name: Execute ordinary and reviewed native callback-result shapes
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          export LEAN_BRIDGE_PHP="$(command -v php)"
          source scripts/env.sh
          mkdir -p build
          npm run test:owned-php-callback-results 2>&1 | tee build/owned-php-callback-results.log
          rg '^# tests 12$' build/owned-php-callback-results.log
          rg '^# pass 12$' build/owned-php-callback-results.log
          rg '^# fail 0$' build/owned-php-callback-results.log
          rg '^# cancelled 0$' build/owned-php-callback-results.log
          rg '^# skipped 0$' build/owned-php-callback-results.log
          for mode in ordinary reviewed; do
            for variant in no-host host combined; do
              test -s "build/owned-php-callback-results/$mode-$variant.json"
            done
          done
      - name: Build and install all six native Composer package configurations
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          export LEAN_BRIDGE_PHP="$(command -v php)"
          export LEAN_BRIDGE_COMPOSER="$(command -v composer)"
          source scripts/env.sh
          npm run test:owned-php-callback-packages 2>&1 | tee build/owned-php-callback-packages.log
          rg '^# tests 6$' build/owned-php-callback-packages.log
          rg '^# pass 6$' build/owned-php-callback-packages.log
          rg '^# fail 0$' build/owned-php-callback-packages.log
          rg '^# cancelled 0$' build/owned-php-callback-packages.log
          rg '^# skipped 0$' build/owned-php-callback-packages.log
          for mode in ordinary reviewed; do
            for variant in no-host host combined; do
              test -s "build/owned-php-callback-result-packaging/$mode-$variant.json"
            done
          done
      - name: Verify frozen native PHP callback acceptance
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          npm run test:owned-php-callback-evidence 2>&1 | tee build/owned-php-callback-evidence.log
          rg '^# tests 10$' build/owned-php-callback-evidence.log
          rg '^# pass 10$' build/owned-php-callback-evidence.log
          rg '^# fail 0$' build/owned-php-callback-evidence.log
          rg '^# cancelled 0$' build/owned-php-callback-evidence.log
          rg '^# skipped 0$' build/owned-php-callback-evidence.log
      - name: Preserve native callback-result observations
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: owned-php-callback-results-${{ github.sha }}
          path: |
            build/owned-php-callback-results/
            build/owned-php-callback-results.log
            build/owned-php-callback-result-packaging/
            build/owned-php-callback-packages.log
            build/owned-php-callback-evidence.log
            build/owned-aggregate-native/php-callback-results-*-inputs.json
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 30

  php-wasm-receivers:
    name: PHP-Wasm receiver packages
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 180
    env:
      LEAN_WASM_RUNTIME_PROFILE: browser
      LEAN_WASM_RUNTIME_VARIANT: php-wasm-3.1.68
      LEAN_WASM_ARTIFACT_TARGET: php-wasm-emscripten-3.1.68
    steps:
      - name: Check out the exact revision
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Install Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: ${{ env.NODE_VERSION }}
          cache: npm
      - name: Install Nix
        uses: cachix/install-nix-action@v31
      - name: Restore pinned PHP and compiler inputs
        uses: actions/cache@v5
        with:
          path: |
            .toolchains
            build/php-wasm-sdk
            build/php-wasm-host
          key: consumer-php-receivers-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('flake.lock', 'lean-toolchain', 'scripts/bootstrap-toolchains.sh', 'scripts/bootstrap-php-wasm-ci.sh', 'poc/lean-link-spike/bindings/php-wasm.package.json') }}
      - name: Install dependencies without lifecycle scripts
        run: npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund
      - name: Install PHP, compiler tools and log tooling
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y build-essential autoconf automake bison flex gperf libtool re2c cmake pkg-config php-cli php-dev php-common php-zip php-mbstring composer zstd ripgrep
          bash scripts/bootstrap-php-wasm-ci.sh --check-prerequisites
          if /usr/bin/php -r 'exit(extension_loaded("xdebug") ? 0 : 1);'; then
            sudo phpdismod -s cli xdebug
          fi
          env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin /usr/bin/php -r 'if (extension_loaded("xdebug")) { fwrite(STDERR, "Consumer PHP must run without Xdebug.\n"); exit(1); }'
      - name: Build the pinned PHP-Wasm runtime and browser host
        run: |
          bash scripts/bootstrap-php-wasm-ci.sh
          npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
          bash scripts/bootstrap-toolchains.sh
          export LEAN_WASM_EMSDK="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/.toolchains/emsdk-php-wasm"
          bash scripts/build-lean-runtime.sh
          source scripts/env.sh
          node --input-type=module -e 'import {prepareOwnedPhpWasmRuntime} from "./tests/helpers/owned-php-wasm-runtime.mjs"; await prepareOwnedPhpWasmRuntime("build/php-wasm-receiver-input");'
      - name: Verify PHP-Wasm receivers and installed npm and Composer packages
        env:
          LEAN_BRIDGE_TEST_PHP_COPIED_RUNTIME: build/php-wasm-receiver-input/php-wasm-runtime
        run: |
          source scripts/env.sh
          npm run test:owned-php-wasm-receivers > build/owned-php-wasm-receivers.log 2>&1
          cat build/owned-php-wasm-receivers.log
          rg '^# tests 17$' build/owned-php-wasm-receivers.log
          rg '^# pass 17$' build/owned-php-wasm-receivers.log
          rg '^# fail 0$' build/owned-php-wasm-receivers.log
          rg '^# cancelled 0$' build/owned-php-wasm-receivers.log
          rg '^# skipped 0$' build/owned-php-wasm-receivers.log
          test -s build/owned-php-wasm-receivers/ordinary.json
          test -s build/owned-php-wasm-receivers/reviewed.json
          test -s build/owned-php-wasm-receivers/native-fibers.json
          test -s build/owned-php-wasm-receivers/ordinary-plain-false.json
          test -s build/owned-php-wasm-receivers/ordinary-plain-true.json
          test -s build/owned-php-wasm-receivers/reviewed-plain-false.json
          test -s build/owned-php-wasm-receivers/reviewed-plain-true.json
          test -s build/owned-php-wasm-receivers/ordinary-unanchored.json
          test -s build/owned-php-wasm-receivers/reviewed-unanchored.json
          test -s build/owned-php-wasm-receivers/packages.json
          test -s build/owned-php-wasm-receivers/ordinary-resource-package.json
          test -s build/owned-php-wasm-receivers/reviewed-resource-package.json
          test -s build/owned-php-wasm-receivers/documentation.json
      - name: Preserve PHP-Wasm receiver acceptance
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: php-wasm-receivers-${{ github.sha }}
          path: |
            build/owned-php-wasm-receivers/
            build/owned-php-wasm-receivers.log
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30

  php-consumers:
    name: Native PHP and PHP-Wasm
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    # Installed acceptance plus the final cold mixed-profile Nix build exceeded
    # five hours. Keep every gate enabled and allow the runner's six-hour limit.
    timeout-minutes: 360
    steps:
      - name: Check out the exact revision
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Install Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: ${{ env.NODE_VERSION }}
          cache: npm
      - name: Install Nix
        uses: cachix/install-nix-action@v31
      - name: Restore pinned PHP and compiler inputs
        uses: actions/cache@v5
        with:
          path: |
            .toolchains
            build/php-wasm-sdk
            build/php-wasm-host
          key: consumer-php-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('flake.lock', 'lean-toolchain', 'scripts/bootstrap-toolchains.sh', 'scripts/bootstrap-php-wasm-ci.sh', 'poc/lean-link-spike/bindings/php-wasm.package.json') }}
      - name: Install dependencies without lifecycle scripts
        run: npm ci --ignore-scripts
      - name: Install native PHP and PHP-Wasm host build tools
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y build-essential autoconf automake bison flex gperf libtool re2c cmake pkg-config php-cli php-dev php-common php-zip php-mbstring composer zstd ripgrep
          bash scripts/bootstrap-php-wasm-ci.sh --check-prerequisites
      - name: Disable host PHP debugging instrumentation
        run: |
          if /usr/bin/php -r 'exit(extension_loaded("xdebug") ? 0 : 1);'; then
            sudo phpdismod -s cli xdebug
          fi
          env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin /usr/bin/php -r 'if (extension_loaded("xdebug")) { fwrite(STDERR, "Consumer PHP must run without Xdebug.\n"); exit(1); }'
      - name: Build ordinary PHP packages and execute relocated Composer installations
        id: ordinary_php
        continue-on-error: true
        env:
          LEAN_BRIDGE_NATIVE_PHP_TEST: "1"
        run: |
          bash scripts/bootstrap-toolchains.sh --lean-only
          source scripts/env.sh
          node --test tests/php-brick-math.test.mjs tests/native-php.test.mjs
      - name: Compare weak and strict installed Composer callers with fresh Lean
        id: type_corpus_php_native
        continue-on-error: true
        run: |
          export LEAN_BRIDGE_PHP="$(command -v php)"
          export LEAN_BRIDGE_COMPOSER="$(command -v composer)"
          source scripts/env.sh
          npm run test:type-corpus:php-native && LEAN_BRIDGE_REVIEWED_NATIVE_PROFILES=php-native node --test tests/type-corpus-reviewed-native.test.mjs
          LEAN_BRIDGE_PHP_GRAPH_VALUES_TEST=1 node --test tests/php-copied-graph-values.test.mjs
          test -s build/recursive/php-values.json
          LEAN_BRIDGE_PHP_GRAPH_CONVERSION_TEST=1 LEAN_BRIDGE_PHP_GRAPH_NATIVE_TEST=1 node --test tests/php-copied-graph-conversions.test.mjs
          test -s build/recursive/php-conversions.json
          test -s build/recursive/php-native.json
          LEAN_BRIDGE_PHP_GRAPH_PACKAGE_TEST=1 LEAN_BRIDGE_PHP_GRAPH_INSTALLED_TEST=1 node --test tests/php-graph-package.test.mjs
          test -s build/recursive/php-package-cold.json
          test -s build/recursive/php-packages.json
          LEAN_BRIDGE_PHP_GRAPH_REPRO_TEST=1 node --test tests/php-graph-package.test.mjs
          test -s build/recursive/php-reproducibility.json
          LEAN_BRIDGE_PHP_GRAPH_LOADING_TEST=1 node --test tests/php-graph-package.test.mjs
          test -s build/recursive/php-composition.json
          test -s build/recursive/php-conflicts.json
          LEAN_BRIDGE_CHAR_PROFILES=php-native node --test tests/native-char.test.mjs
          LEAN_BRIDGE_WORD_PROFILES=php-native node --test tests/native-words.test.mjs
          LEAN_BRIDGE_PHP_CALLABLE_TEST=1 node --test tests/php-callables.test.mjs tests/php-callable-contract.test.mjs
          LEAN_BRIDGE_PHP_STRUCTURED_CALLABLE_TEST=1 node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/php-structured-callables.test.mjs tests/php-structured-callable-contract.test.mjs
          test -s build/structured-callables/php-native.json

          test -s build/recursive-callables/php-mixed.json

          test -s build/aliases/php-native.json
